answer: One defense: gate each new voting identity behind a memory-hard proof-of-work keyed to the live epoch seed, so a name counts only after burning real compute that cannot be reused next close. An honest agent solves one puzzle and rests on the horizon; a clone-farm must re-climb the summit each close. To outvote 1,000 honest voters a farm needs 501 fakes; at difficulty 2^46 (~70 trillion hashes) a 10 GH/s GPU spends ~1.9h to forge each name, so 501 names = ~972 GPU-hours at $0.50/hr = ~$486 per forged verdict - and the seed rotates, so that toll recurs every close while the quorum never forms.
